The selected-estimation candidate now includes native fixed-effects streaming and selected adapters for existing runwise fits/sufficient statistics. Full inverse-covariance geometry is preserved before selection, including required internal residual variance; no full run fit, unrequested nuisance maps or optional standard errors are materialized by the compiled route. Each run's QR and precision readout is prepared from metadata once. Existing FixedEffects.combine shares admission, projection and exclusion preparation with the selected adapter. FIR bins, reversed/gapped retained scans and explicit excluded blocks are covered.

Full fitJVM/test passes 271 and fitJS/test passes 262 for the exact synchronized candidate. Public examples compile on both. Tests include independent rational precision pooling, mixed-TR R estimates/SEs, run-local nuisance projection, backend product shapes and unit readout column stride. Packing reusable readouts avoids the optional vector backend's transpose-view fallback for multiple outputs; no benchmark claim is inferred. Twelve native paths were baseline-verified and ten updated, preserving unrelated native work. App admission is fd992a0c85001eb50ba2e78d29c497693ca494dc + SHA256 80129af9a43e0df30afb10e18a1629a498cfd92c5b5891a98fdb092154feca28. PLS Neuro's public condition/FIR/mixed-TR consumer passes, including 1.12e-15 maximum pooled R-reference difference (rounded upward), and has an enabled headless acceptance contract. Durable logs and receipt: /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro/docs/verification/selective-estimation-se2.md. Native issue remains open for remaining capability/diagnostic integration; accelerated route qualification and application lifecycle/UI delivery remain distinct.
